subject: Respect selected priority when projecting pending Halt
description: nicouzouf Profile_001 Savegame_039 replay-006 diverged after frame 221 because Soldier29's pending Halt(PREFERENCE) was projected as exposing idle while its selected ReceiveArrowDamage/ExtractingArrowBow sequence had stronger Injury priority. Original Stop(PREFERENCE) cannot interrupt Injury, so ReturnToDuty's near-waypoint GoTo does not take the idle shortcut and remains DefaultGotoRoute. Every live AI context now carries required selected-element priority metadata; pending Halt projects idle only when the selection is actually interruptible, with strict missing/unresolved metadata handling. Focused Injury and equal-Preference controls pass. Three representatives clear the shared frame-221 family and advance to independent frontiers.
